description: A farmer on an island sends corn to the main land either by ferry or light rail. Each ferry trip can take 20 boxes of corn while each light rail trip can take 15 boxes of corn. Since ferry trips are slow, the number of light rail trip has to be at least 4 times the number of ferry trips. If the farmer wants to send at least 500 boxes of corn, minimize the total number of trips of either type needed.

FerryTripCapacity.definition: Number of boxes of corn that can be sent per ferry trip

LightRailTripCapacity.definition: Number of boxes of corn that can be sent per light rail trip

MinLightRailMultiplier.definition: Minimum multiple that the number of light rail trips must be compared to ferry trips

MinBoxesToSend.definition: Minimum number of boxes of corn that the farmer wants to send

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of ferry and light rail trips required to send at least the minimum required number of boxes of corn"

constraints.description: 20 * (Number of ferry trips) + 15 * (Number of light rail trips) >= 500
Number of light rail trips >= 4 * (Number of ferry trips)
Number of ferry trips and number of light rail trips must be nonnegative integers

FerryTrips.definition: Number of ferry trips used to transport corn

LightRailTrips.definition: Number of light rail trips used to transport corn
